correctness.rationale: Invariant affine hyperplanes hitting the cross-polytope have Gaussian normal density weighted by M=max|G_i| and uniform signed level; integrating 0<S<M yields the exact binomial mixture for K=#(|G_i|>S). A generic (r-1)-face is sectioned iff its r signed vertices cross S; subtraction of all-high and all-low configurations gives the boxed complete face vector, F_0=K(2n-K-1). Gaussian projection-width integration yields E F_j=2^r C(n,r) E max_{r}G_i/E max_{n}|G_i|. Gaussian maximum/Mills bounds give S/sqrt(2log n)=>U; conditional binomial concentration gives log K/log n=>1-U² and K/n->0; leading face counts are (2^(j+1)/(j+1)!) K n^(j+1) jointly at any fixed ranks, yielding all limiting assertions. Independently checked signed face enumeration at 20 finite generic configurations. These finite tests do not establish the joint n→∞ theorem.
